analogy.rationale: ROCK inhibitors act on the AGC-family kinases ROCK1/2 and related kinases such as PKN2 and PRKCE, so other kinase inhibitors targeting overlapping AGC/calcium-dependent signaling should give partially similar responses, but ROCK's main outputs (cytoskeletal contraction, focal adhesion) are not a dominant transcriptional program in these lines, so overall response is expected to be weak.
